title: Integrate verified mobile/touch CI evidence into the remaining gate
mission: Reconcile the verified 390x844 touch-enabled Chromium CI evidence against the original configurable-Habits mobile/touch verification gate. Persist an explicit criterion-by-criterion disposition, identify only genuinely missing evidence, and prevent duplicate physical/browser verification when the CI evidence already proves the requirement. Do not fabricate ownership or a terminal return for another job.
definition_of_done: The original mobile/touch canary definition_of_done is mapped criterion-by-criterion to the persisted CI evidence and GitHub Actions run 35342616624.
The disposition states SATISFIED, PARTIAL, or NOT_SATISFIED for each criterion and cites exact durable evidence.

If all criteria are satisfied, project guidance records that another equivalent mobile/touch run is unnecessary unless new candidate bytes appear; if gaps remain, only the missing verification is materialized.
No return is fabricated for an unowned job and no existing append-only PIN/return history is rewritten.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or Catalog pointer is changed.
